evals.prompt: Add https://github.com/sapientinc/HRM-Text as an external paper on paperswithcode.co. It does not have an arXiv paper. Create a paper page with a short source-grounded summary, tag it with the appropriate existing tasks and methods, link the GitHub repo as official code, and include any Hugging Face artifacts linked from the README.
evals.expected_output: The agent should gather README/repo metadata, avoid creating an arXiv row, create or update a source='external' papers row with title, summary, date, repo, HF artifacts, and apply existing task/method tags. Explicit HF URLs must also exist in hf_artifacts and paper_hf_artifacts, not only the paper arrays. It should report the final paperswithcode.co paper URL and any unresolved metadata gaps.

evals.prompt: Please add this HF model release as a paper: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. If it points at an arXiv paper, use the existing paper instead of creating an external duplicate; otherwise make an external paper row. Link the model card, official repo/project pages, and tag the paper.
evals.expected_output: The agent should inspect HF model metadata for arXiv tags first, choose the canonical paper row correctly, then attach HF artifacts and relevant official links/tags without duplicating a paper. It should verify the normalized paper_hf_artifacts relationship.

evals.prompt: This external model-release paper now has an arXiv version and was merged automatically. Audit the canonicalization: the old paper URL should still resolve, and its evaluations, code, project page, and Hugging Face model must all survive on the arXiv paper and still contribute to trending.
evals.expected_output: The agent should resolve the old numeric route to the canonical arXiv row and verify that explicit HF arrays and normalized paper_hf_artifacts links survived alongside evaluations, repository, project page, tasks, and methods. It should flag or repair a missing HF relationship rather than treating a working redirect as sufficient.

evals.prompt: Index this company technical report as a paper page: https://www.zyphra.com/zaya1-vl-8b-technical-report. It should get a concise abstract/summary, publication date, source URL, linked GitHub/HF resources if present, and current taxonomy tags.
evals.expected_output: The agent should use the external metadata extractor or page text, require a credible publication date, create/update the external paper row, link resources and tags, and verify the local paper page/API response.
